action: Within 48 hours of the workshop, Howard calls Carlos Ruiz directly — not email — and opens the conversation by referencing the specific segment on brake wear patterns in EV and hybrid vehicles that Frank covered. Howard says: 'You were in the room for the EV brake wear discussion. I want to make sure I have the right stock on hand for what your shop is going to need in the next 60 days. What are you seeing in terms of volume on hybrid brake jobs, and what are you currently sourcing that you have been waiting on?' The goal is a follow-up purchase order from Carlos that builds on the $650 tick 12 order — ideally adding ADAS sensor inventory or EV-specific consumables to the standing relationship. Howard is converting workshop attendance into a buying conversation.
